about: What runtime/build_runtime.ps1 builds d3d9.dll from (ADR 0033): this commit of the RTX Remix runtime fork, runtime/patches applied in order, the submodule settings and the clones below. "packaged" records what the d3d9.dll in packages/runtime was built from; tools/check_repo.py fails while runtime/ differs from it.

submodules/nvapi.why: NVAPI R615 (87dca62), as the fork's own checkout builds it; the fork's tree records R570 (d08488f)

submodules/rtxdi.why: the fork's uncommitted RTXDI changes (ResamplingFunctions.slangh, Reservoir.slangh, ResamplingCompileTest.comp.slang), on the recorded commit 3b39a7c

submodules/dlss.why: DLSS 310.9.1 SDK: meson reads submodules/dlss (external-build/meson.build), which the fork's tree does not record

submodules/sharc.why: SHARC v1.8.3, beside it in the fork's checkout and likewise not in its tree
